To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a reliable method based on UFLC-QTRap-MS/MS was established to simultaneously quantify the contents of 2 cyclopeptides,12 nucleosides and 16 amino acid compounds in PR, and the quality of PR from different growing habitats was evaluated based on the contents of these compounds combined with GRA.

a UFLC-QTRP-MS/MS method was developed for simultaneous determination of 30 bioactive components in PR, and the quality of PR from 6 August 3 was better than that from other harvesting time, different growing habitats and different processing methods.

we developed a new approach based on the UFLC-QTRP-MS/MS method and the GRA model to evaluate the quality and grade of PR, and the results showed that the PR harvested in 2013, grown in Jurong, and treated by drying at 60 °C is the most suitable for clinical application.
In summary, our research is concerned with
quality control of PR, which is helpful for the rational utilization of this precious medicinal material.
a new approach for the evaluation of PR quality and provides a reference for the quality control of other TCMs.
quality control of TCM based on simultaneous determination and grey relational analysis of multiple bioactive constituents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality of Pseudostellaire Radix harvested in 6th August 2013 in Jurong, cultivated in Jiangsu province and treated by oven dried at 60°C is better than that of others.
PR harvested in 2013 and cultivated in Jurong was better than other PR samples.
the quality of the PR harvested in 2013 August, cultivated in Jurang, Jiangsu, treated by drying at 60 °C is better than the other PR samples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality of the PR harvested in 2013 was better than that in 2012.
the quality evaluation of PR based on simultaneous determination and grey relational analysis is a reliable method for quality control of TCM.

the proposed method based on simultaneous determination combined with GRA is a powerful tool to evaluate the quality and to choose the optimal cultivation and processing methods for PR, and this method could be used to evaluate the quality for other Chinese herbal medicines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of UFLC-MS and GRA can be used to evaluate the quality control of PR.

the quality of Pseudostellaire Radix (PR), an important traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), can be comprehensively evaluated based on simultaneous analysis of its multiple bioactive components, which provides a new idea for the quality control of TCM.
we developed a new method for the comprehensive evaluation on the quality of TCM based on simultaneous determination and GRA.
